name: ai-parallel-web
description: Controlled, evidence-first comparison of approved public web journeys.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@ai-parallel-web/contracts --workspace=@ai-parallel-web/domain --workspace=@ai-parallel-web/auth --workspace=@ai-parallel-web/db --workspace=@ai-parallel-web/storage && npm run build --workspace=@ai-parallel-web/capture --workspace=@ai-parallel-web/comparison --workspace=@ai-parallel-web/observability && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run contracts:validate
scripts.contracts:validate: redocly lint --config config/tooling/redocly.yaml packages/contracts/openapi/openapi.yaml && vitest run --config config/tooling/vitest.config.ts tests/contract/schemas.test.ts
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace=@ai-parallel-web/domain --workspace=@ai-parallel-web/auth --workspace=@ai-parallel-web/db --workspace=@ai-parallel-web/storage && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && tsc -p config/tooling/tsconfig.tests.json --noEmit
